snippet.title: Starless Umbra Gameplay Trailer [2026]
snippet.description:
Starless Umbra is a story-rich action RPG inspired by the best of classic and modern JRPGs. Engage in real-time combat and explore puzzle-filled dungeons in a couch co-op adventure where friendship and loyalty are tested in a world consumed by a noxious fog. 

📝 Wishlist/Playtest Starless Umbra: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101780/Starless_Umbra/
☕ Support me on ko-fi for early access to Act 2: https://ko-fi.com/zexyu
🦋 Follow me on bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/starlessumbra.com

Check out the rest of my development videos for Starless Umbra:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhyTskWjjQjgV3t7MKp3Y7-wr2IcskG47&si=Vh9HgmC2rzl3IMWr
